Subject: SIG/CAIQ evidence & temporary tenant-log retention ask

Hi Rishi / team,

Quick intro: I’m Sophie (security lead) at Aileron Biosystems. We’re running a vendor security evaluation ahead of a customer pilot and the auditors requested both a SIG/CAIQ export and confirmation that we can request a tenant-scoped log retention extension for forensic purposes. Two asks: 1) a CAIQ/SIG subset that maps to Redwood’s log retention controls and 2) a temporary retention carveout for our tenant (we’re asking for 45 days for debug/session logs) that won’t affect other customers.

Audit window is the week of Sep 14; can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide the SIG/CAIQ export or an equivalent mapping PDF (evidence of control mappings), and
- Support a tenant-scoped retention increase to 45 days for "session-debug" + "request-trace" logs for Aileron only (no change to default global TTL), and
- Provide an evidence package showing the process for later secure deletion and attestations

If you can share a rough ETA and what the deliverables will look like that would be really helpful.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Security Lead | Aileron Biosystems
S: +1 415-555-0147
attachments: list request (evidence manifest preferred)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ evidence & temporary tenant-log retention ask

Sophie — thanks for the clear ask. Welcome — we’ll own this through to delivery. High level: we can produce a CAIQ/SIG subset that highlights our log-retention controls and provide a tenant-scoped temporary retention path, but we need sign-off from infra/security for the execution details and an explicit customer request/PO amendment for the change in retention SLA.

Proposed plan / next steps:
1) Priyom (security eng) to confirm technical approach and provide a retention matrix + evidence bundle (ETA 48 hours).
2) We’ll generate a SIG/CAIQ subset PDF that maps Redwood controls to the specific evidence artifacts you’ll receive (config exports, retention policies, deletion attestations).
3) If Aileron approves, we’ll carry out a tenant-level config change to move the logs to a soft-archive tier for 45 days and provide a proof-of-archive export and deletion procedure (and a secure deletion attestation after the hold expires).

One ask from our side: please confirm whether Aileron needs a signed amendment to the contract or whether a simple written approval from your procurement/security mailbox suffices for your auditors.

I’ve looped in Priyom and Laura to expedite. We’ll respond with the evidence package and a proposed timeline by end of day Friday (Sep 11).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference

Hi all — technical note and what I’m attaching.

TL;DR: Tenant-scoped 45-day retention for the named log streams is feasible without changing the global TTL. We implement it by creating a tenant policy that routes matching log keys to a soft-archive tier with an independent TTL. The archived data is encrypted using the same KMS keys and is scoped by tenant-id.

Deliverables attached:
- AILERON_SIG_SUBSET.pdf (SIG/CAIQ control mapping + evidence pointers)
- retention_matrix_aileron.xlsx (matrix: log type → storage class → retention TTL → deletion flow)
- Implementation plan (steps we’ll run in infra) — included in the retention matrix notes column.

Security notes / constraints:
- We will not change bucket-level policies that affect other tenants. The tenant policy is a routing rule applied at the ingress layer.
- We’ll create an export (tenant_log_escrow_export_AILERON_20260911.zip) with an inventory of archived objects and hashes as deliverable; that export is timeboxed and encrypted for transfer.
- Post-hold, we will run our secure-delete job and provide an attestation PDF.

ETA: I can produce the export and attestations within 48 hours after written approval from Aileron. Delivery method: secure S3 share (pre-signed) + MD5 checksums.

Attachments: AILERON_SIG_SUBSET.pdf (type: pdf), retention_matrix_aileron.xlsx (type: xlsx)

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference

Sophie — thanks for the quick thread. Confirming Redwood is able to proceed on the plan Priyom outlined. Next steps from Aileron: please reply to this thread with formal approval to enact the 45-day, tenant-only retention for the specified streams and confirm the auditor contact info for delivery. Once we have that written approval we will:

1) Run the tenant-routing change and place qualifying keys into the soft-archive (no downtime).
2) Produce the tenant export (tenant_log_escrow_export_AILERON_20260911.zip) and upload to a secure artifact share; you’ll get MD5s and an S3 pre-signed URL.
3) Deliver the SIG/CAIQ subset and retention matrix (attached).
4) After 45 days we’ll run the secure-delete job and provide a deletion attestation PDF.

If Aileron’s procurement requires a short amendment (a one-paragraph SLA addendum), we can generate that and route for signature; happy to coordinate.

Laura Bennett
